v7_shape_progress_cause: At progress 0 the v7 centerline already used the full bow term; its wave blend was zero through progress 0.30, so those frames reused the same bowed centerline.
v8_shape_progress_fix: Phase 1 explicitly sets all centerline deformation coefficients to zero; Phase 2 smoothsteps a single 12 mm bow from zero; Phase 3 keeps that bow at its boundary and gradually adds 3π, 5π, 7π harmonics plus a smooth asymmetric term.
